affordance_in_statement: The selection is valid if and only if the sum of the squares of these counts over all possible values of x is exactly 3k: $$ \sum_x (c_1(x)^2+c_2(x)^2+c_3(x)^2)=3k $$
removal_suggestion: No wording-only removal is available without changing the core task: because each coordinate count sums to k, equality to 3k is intrinsically equivalent to every selected first, second, and third coordinate being distinct. Re-presenting the condition can obscure this fact but cannot eliminate the affordance.
